Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

born — coming into life. Example: She was born in 1950.
childhood — the time when you were a child. Example: In her childhood she loved music.
family — parents, children and relatives. Example: Her family lived in a small town.
school — a place where children learn. Example: She started school at six.
work — to do a job. Example: He worked as a teacher.
famous — known by many people. Example: She was a famous singer.
life — the time you are alive. Example: It is a long life.
story — a description of events. Example: It is a famous story.
history — events of the past. Example: The invention changed history.
died — stopped living. Example: She died in 2020.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• He was born in ...
• She was a ...
• In her childhood she ...
• He died in ...
• It is a famous story.
